tagRefs.description: Opaque references of catalog tags attached to the item.

standardSalePriceMin.description: Minimum standard sale price in cents among the item's non-archived SKUs.

consumptionUnit.description: Inventory owner's unit used to consume this BOM target.

configuration.description: Inventory owner's current configuration for this BOM target.

allowNegative.description: Whether the inventory balance for this target may become negative.

lowStockThreshold.description: Configured low-stock threshold for this inventory target.

countingUnit.description: Inventory unit in which this target's balance is counted.

conversionFactor.description: Conversion factor from the consumption unit to the counting unit.
